info.title: MoveMe API
info.description:
MoveMe ride-pooling platform backend service.

### How to Authenticate
1. **Register**: Call `POST /auth/register/passenger` or `POST /auth/register/driver` to create an account.
2. **Log In**: Call `POST /auth/login` with your registered email and password.
3. **Copy Token**: Copy the `accessToken` string from the 200 response body.
4. **Click Authorize**: Click the **Authorize** button (lock icon) at the top right of this page.
5. **Paste Token**: Paste the token into the Value field and click **Authorize**.

### User Roles & Capabilities
- **PASSENGER**: Can search upcoming departures, view active routes, reserve seats, initiate payments, cancel reservations, view personal reservation and payment histories, and read in-app notifications.
- **DRIVER**: Can register vehicles, publish solo and pooled departures once verified by admin, view active routes, advance departure trip lifecycle (/arrive, /depart, /complete), cancel departures, and view passengers booked on their departures.
- **ADMIN**: Can review unverified driver registrations and enable or disable driver publishing privileges.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your Bearer JWT token (without 'Bearer ' prefix)

error.description: Descriptive error message explaining the failure reason.

get.description: Returns all active routes ordered by pickup point. Accessible by any authenticated user regardless of role.

200.description: List of active routes ordered by pickup point

post.description: Creates a PENDING payment for a reservation if the hold is still valid.

403.description: Forbidden - not your reservation or wrong role

409.description: Reservation not pending payment or hold already expired

example.error: Reservation is no longer pending payment or hold has expired

get.description: Retrieves details of a reservation. Accessible only by the passenger who owns it or the driver who owns the departure. Opportunistically updates any PENDING_PAYMENT reservation whose hold elapsed to EXPIRED before responding.

403.description: Forbidden - not your reservation, not your departure, or insufficient permissions

post.description: Passenger cancels a confirmed reservation before departure time and before trip start. Triggers simulated refund.

200.description: Reservation cancelled successfully with simulated refund

403.description: Forbidden - not your reservation or not a passenger

409.description: Conflict - reservation not confirmed, departure time passed, or trip already in progress

example.error: Only a confirmed reservation can be cancelled

post.description: Internal simulated PSP webhook callback to settle payments. Performs critical MM-06 validity checks.

200.description: Callback processed (SUCCEEDED/FAILED) or safely ignored as no-op (IGNORED for late or duplicate callbacks)

message.example: Late callback on expired reservation - payment marked EXPIRED

ignored.summary: Late or duplicate callback safely ignored

value.message: Late callback on expired reservation - payment marked EXPIRED

400.description: Invalid payment ID format or payload

example.error: Invalid callback payload: outcome must be 'SUCCESS' or 'FAILURE'

404.description: Payment or associated reservation not found

get.description: Retrieves all reservations belonging to the authenticated passenger, ordered by created_at descending. Opportunistically updates any stale PENDING_PAYMENT reservations whose hold has elapsed to EXPIRED before responding. Includes trip_status and departure timestamps.

200.description: List of reservations owned by the caller

get.description: Retrieves all notifications belonging to the authenticated passenger, ordered newest first (created_at DESC). Supports ?unread=true query filter.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: If true, only return unread notifications (where read_at is null)

patch.description: Marks a notification as read if it is currently unread. Idempotent. Requires PASSENGER role and ownership.

post.description: Registers a new vehicle for the authenticated driver.

get.description: Retrieves all vehicles belonging to the authenticated driver. Enforces strict data ownership so drivers only see their own vehicles.

200.description: List of vehicles owned by the authenticated driver

get.description: Retrieves all departures published by the authenticated driver, ordered soonest first (departure_time ASC). Each item includes status, mode, departure_time, capacity, available_capacity, and counts of confirmed and pending reservations.

200.description: List of departures owned by caller

get.description: Searches scheduled departures by route, mode, and timing. Immediate mode looks for departures within 15 minutes from now. Scheduled mode queries departures matching or after the given datetime. Requires PASSENGER role.

parameters.name: when
parameters.description: Search window type (immediate = next 15 mins, scheduled = target datetime)

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: Required when when=scheduled. Target departure ISO datetime.

post.description: Publishes a new departure. Requires DRIVER role, driver must be enabled (driver_enabled=true), vehicle must belong to the driver and be active, and route must exist and be active. Prevents overlapping departures via database exclusion constraints.

403.description: Driver not enabled or vehicle does not belong to driver

error.example: Driver is not enabled to publish departures

example.error: Driver is not enabled to publish departures

error.example: Overlapping departure detected for this driver or vehicle

example.error: Overlapping departure detected for this driver or vehicle

post.description: Reserves a seat on a scheduled departure using the capacity-guard transaction. Holds capacity for 5 minutes (HOLD_MINUTES) in PENDING_PAYMENT status. Identical code path for SOLO and POOLED departures. Requires PASSENGER role.

409.description: Departure ineligible, no capacity, or duplicate active reservation

error.example: No available capacity on this departure

example.error: No available capacity on this departure

post.description: Driver marks vehicle arrival at pickup point. Departure status must be SCHEDULED. Sets status to ARRIVED and arrived_at timestamp. Driver can only have one active trip in progress or arrived.

403.description: Forbidden (not a driver or not the departure owner)

example.error: Forbidden: you do not own this departure

409.description: Invalid state transition or active trip already in progress

example.error: Cannot arrive: departure status is ARRIVED, expected SCHEDULED

post.description: Driver marks departure underway (trip start). Departure status must be ARRIVED. Sets status to IN_PROGRESS and departed_at timestamp.

403.description: Forbidden (not a driver or not the departure owner)

example.error: Forbidden: you do not own this departure
Cannot depart: departure status is SCHEDULED, expected ARRIVED

post.description: Driver marks departure completed. Departure status must be IN_PROGRESS. Sets status to COMPLETED, completed_at timestamp, and moves all CONFIRMED reservations on this departure to COMPLETED in the same transaction.

403.description: Forbidden (not a driver or not the departure owner)

example.error: Forbidden: you do not own this departure
Cannot complete: departure status is ARRIVED, expected IN_PROGRESS

post.description: Driver cancels a scheduled or arrived departure. Cancels all active reservations with cancellation_reason DEPARTURE_CANCELLED, marks SUCCEEDED payments as REFUNDED, marks PENDING payments as EXPIRED, generates passenger notifications, and frees the driver and vehicle time slots.

403.description: Forbidden (not driver or not departure owner)

example.error: Forbidden: you do not own this departure
Cannot cancel departure: status is IN_PROGRESS, expected SCHEDULED or ARRIVED

post.description: Creates a new user account with PASSENGER role.
Creates a new user account with DRIVER role. The driver account initially has driver_enabled set to false until verified and enabled by an admin.
Authenticates a user by email and password, returning a JWT token with sub and role claims.

get.description: Lists drivers with optional status filtering. When status is set to pending, only drivers awaiting enablement (driver_enabled=false) are returned. Requires ADMIN role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter drivers by status (e.g. pending for unapproved drivers)

200.description: List of drivers matching the filter

patch.description: Enables or disables a driver account. Enabling a driver is required before they can publish departures. Requires ADMIN role.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User UUID of the driver to enable or disable

get.summary: Check service operational health and database readiness (Public).
get.description: Returns 200 with status ok when the service is healthy.
